info.description: Bounded simulator subset of the official AWS Artifact API (2018-05-10). Every other official operation returns HTTP 501 UnknownOperationException. Only the account notification setting is stored: no notification is ever sent to anyone and no report, agreement or term exists. GetReport, GetReportMetadata, GetTermForReport, ListReports and ListCustomerAgreements return UnknownOperationException with HTTP 501 because the compliance documents are AWS-owned. The setting starts as NOT_SUBSCRIBED before the first Put. The service is global, so the setting is shared by every Region the simulator serves.
